_about: Competencies per role and stage band for the 'current role' fit lens (docs/PLAN-HR-V3.md §2.3). Bands: early = idea / pre-seed / seed, scale = series-a, growth = Series B+. Owner-set, not sourced; edit freely.

roles.label: CEO / lead founder
roles.match: \bceo\b|chief executive|managing director|\bmd\b|general director|lead founder|tổng giám đốc|giám đốc điều hành
early: Domain insight into the customer problem
Sold or raised money before (customers, grants or investors)
Built and led a small team
Hands-on in product or sales, not only management
scale: Raised a priced round or led fundraising
Owned a P&L or revenue target
growth: Ran a company or division of 100+ people

roles.label: CTO / technical co-founder
roles.match: \bcto\b|chief technology|chief technical|technical co-?founder|giám đốc công nghệ
early: Built and shipped a production product hands-on
Deep skill in the core technology of the business
Chose architecture and stack under constraints
scale: Owned architecture for scale and reliability

roles.label: CFO / finance lead
roles.match: \bcfo\b|chief financial|finance (?:lead|director|head)|head of finance|giám đốc tài chính
scale: Led a priced round's financial due diligence
growth: Audit and statutory reporting at scale

roles.label: COO / operations lead
early: Set up operations and suppliers from zero
scale: Scaled operations across teams or sites

roles.label: CMO / growth lead
early: Found early customers through tested channels
scale: Built and led a marketing team

roles.label: Sales / commercial lead
roles.match: \bcro\b|chief revenue|chief commercial|head of sales|sales (?:director|lead|manager)|business development|commercial (?:director|lead)|kinh doanh
early: Built a pipeline in the target segment
scale: Owned a revenue quota and hit it

roles.label: Product lead
early: Took a product from idea to first users
Worked closely with engineering and design
scale: Product strategy and roadmap for scale

roles.label: Engineering lead
roles.match: engineering (?:manager|lead|director)|head of engineering|vp engineering|tech lead|lead engineer
early: Hands-on delivery in the core stack

roles.label: Engineer / developer
early: Strong skill in the stack the business uses
scale: Depth in one area (backend, frontend, data, infra)

roles.label: Advisor / board member
early: Opens doors to customers or investors
